title: of the Board in September 2009. Dr. Kiboro was with East African Breweries Limited.
columns:
Mr. Stephen Dunbar-Johnson (58) is
a graduate of Worth School and Kent
University in the United Kingdom. He
has attended an Executive Management
program at the Wharton School, University
of Pennsylvania (USA) and has undertaken
the Sulzberger program at the Colombia
School of Journalism (USA). He is the
President, International of the New York
Times Company and is responsible for the
oversight and strategic development of the
company’s international digital and print
business. Previously, he was the Publisher
of the International Herald Tribune. He was
appointed to the Board in April 2018 and is
a member of the Strategy and Investments
Committee.
